reason: As someone who remembers the refunds and has already given this month, B answers my actual worries: it opens with the failed campaign, shows only $49,000 is left (about what we pledged before), guarantees my money back if it falls short, and is upfront about the roof cost risk and quarterly spending reports. A is warm but vague on why this time is different, never says my pledge is refundable, and leaves the name blank.
